_comment: Ratchet for `homelab mutants`: undetected (survived + untested) mutants per file. Counts may be lowered or removed, never added or raised by hand -- with one measured exception, below. Regenerate with `homelab mutants --update-baseline` after an improvement. Scope lives in [tool.mutmut].only_mutate in pyproject.toml. Baseline is riven-relative; see AGENTS.md.
_drift: crap.py 46, hosts.py 38 and leakcheck.py 44 are exact on every run. module_support.py, normalize.py and op_secrets.py still vary by about 2 between fresh sweeps on riven (observed 31/33, 163/165, 124/126), so those three are pinned to the observed ceiling rather than the last sweep and a re-run warns 'improved' instead of failing on noise. That is the one sanctioned exception to 'never raise by hand'; --update-baseline will overwrite it with that sweep's figure, so restore the ceiling afterwards.
_timeouts: These figures are only comparable to sweeps run with [tool.mutmut].timeout_multiplier set. At mutmut's default the per-mutant CPU cap fired constantly (SIGXCPU, exit -24) and mutmut scores a timeout as killed, so hundreds of mutants were counted as caught without being tested -- hosts.py read 16 undetected in one such sweep against a true 38. Any baseline generated before 2026-09-12 is inflated by that artifact and is not a valid comparison.
